modmenu.descriptionTranslation.accidenta: Prevents you from accidentally attacking the wrong mob when using a sword
accidental-sweep.config.shouldRun.desc: Set to §oFalse§r to turn off the mod
accidental-sweep.config.neutralMobsBol.d: Set to §oFalse§r to disable Neutral Mobs hit prevention
accidental-sweep.config.passiveMobsBol.d: Set to §oFalse§r to disable Passive Mobs hit prevention
accidental-sweep.config.petMobsBol.desc: Set to §oFalse§r to disable Pet Mobs hit prevention
accidental-sweep.config.neutralMobs.desc:
Neutral mobs cannot normally be attacked by a Sweep Attack. They can only be hit if they are the main target and §lwill§r deal a Sweep Attack that §lcan attack§r other mobs of the same type 

§eINFO:§r New entries §lshould§r use the mob translation key. Ex: 
§o"entity.[MOD_ID].[MOB_ID]"§r or §o"entity.minecraft.[MOB_ID]"§r
accidental-sweep.config.passiveMobs.desc:
Passive mobs cannot normally be attacked by a Sweep Attack. They can only be hit if they are the main target and §lwill not§r deal a Sweep Attack on other mobs of the same type 

§eINFO:§r New entries §lshould§r use the mob translation key. Ex: 
§o"entity.[MOD_ID].[MOB_ID]"§r or §o"entity.minecraft.[MOB_ID]"§r
accidental-sweep.config.petMobs.desc:
Pet mobs cannot normally be attacked by the player in any way, unless the player is sneaking or hitting a Critical Attack 

§eINFO:§r New entries §lshould§r use the mob translation key. Ex: 
§o"entity.[MOD_ID].[MOB_ID]"§r or §o"entity.minecraft.[MOB_ID]"§r
accidental-sweep.config.sneakBypass.desc: Allows you to hit a mob while sneaking, even if they are inside one of the lists (Pet Mobs will only be attacked if they are the main target and will not receive a Sweep Attack)
accidental-sweep.config.critBypass: Bypass the prevention on a critical attack
accidental-sweep.config.critBypass.desc: Allows you to hit a critical attack on a mob even if they are inside one of the lists (Only attacks a single mob)
accidental-sweep.config.bypassOnAttack.d: Allows you to hit the mob that is attacking you even if they are inside one of the lists (If enabled, Neutral Mobs will receive a Sweep Attack)
accidental-sweep.config.bypassOnAttackWi: Allows the Sweep Attack to be used on a bypassed attack (Only Neutral Mobs will receive a Sweep Attack)
